name: Standard Electric Supply Co.
old_description: Get SAME-DAY SHIPPING on In Stock orders placed by 2pm CST M-F
about:
Standard Electric Supply Co. is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, and has operated as a family-owned electrical distributor since its founding in 1919. Now in its fourth generation of family leadership, the company began as a local supplier and has grown into a regional partner for industrial automation and control products.

The company maintains 16 stocking locations across Wisconsin, Illinois, and Indiana, holding over $45 million in inventory to support same-day shipping on orders placed by 2 p.m. CST. Its distribution portfolio spans automation components, batteries, hardware, conduit, enclosures, fuses, industrial controls, lighting, motors, drives, sensors, safety equipment, tools, wire, and cable. Beyond product supply, Standard Electric provides 24/7 engineering support, inventory management, enclosure modification, repair services, kitting and custom assemblies, national customer solutions, IIoT integration, a 24-hour support line, and training seminars. The company reports an on-time delivery rate exceeding 99 percent.

Standard Electric serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) environments across industrial sectors. Its customers include facilities that rely on automation and control systems to keep production running, from discrete manufacturing plants to process industries. The company's services are tailored to reduce downtime and manage inventory risk for operations teams facing lean staffing and high reliability demands.

President Larry Stern emphasizes a "tradition of innovation and service" built on continuous improvement, aiming to reduce complexity for customers through fewer handoffs, clearer communication, and accountability for outcomes rather than just orders. The firm's long-term partnership model focuses on adapting support to each facility's unique constraints, whether through engineering expertise, inventory programs, or technical training.
